notes.title: Big update again！
notes.content:
Now the new soul generator will add a new and unique story background to your character every time, and some entries will directly affect the game content (such as Void Naked Runner).
Enriched the main storyline and fragmented plot, now go talk to all NPCs!

notes.title: Big update! The game now have changed a lot!
notes.content: Now each character has their own unique skill, and the dungeon added various puzzle mechanisms which can be solved in different ways! The dungeon now will be randomly generated every time players into the game.

notes.title: New update!
notes.content: Players now can select a language(English or Chinese) before downloading.

notes.title: New update!
notes.content: Players now can select levels rather than talk to the nameless, yet players still need to get in level 2 to unlock the function,
